## Description

Brief summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation or diagram update
- [ ] `test`: Added or improved tests
- [ ] `refactor`: Code improvements without behavior changes
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or repository maintenance

## Affected Subsystems

- [ ] Embedded / Device Simulator (`apps/device-sim`)
- [ ] Edge Gateway (`apps/gateway`)
- [ ] Python Enrollment Toolchain (`apps/enrollment`)
- [ ] Web Companion App (`apps/web`, `src/`)
- [ ] Contracts & Engine (`packages/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`, `study/`)

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` completed without errors
- [ ] `npm run test:all` passed
- [ ] Python tests passed (`pytest apps/enrollment/tests`)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or private database files committed
- [ ] Tested on both Desktop and Mobile views
